## 1. Post-imputation data processing

### 1.1 Variable types

```{r recoding}
# Scale specs

scale_spec <- list(
  pds_c  = list(items = paste0("pds_c_", 1:5),   min = 1,  max = 4),
  pds_y  = list(items = paste0("pds_y_", 1:5),   min = 1,  max = 4),
  ers_c  = list(items = paste0("ers_c_", 1:21),  min = 0,  max = 4),
  ers_y  = list(items = paste0("ers_y_", 1:21),  min = 0,  max = 4),
  smfq_c = list(items = paste0("smfq_c_", 1:13), min = 0,  max = 2),
  smfq_y = list(items = paste0("smfq_y_", 1:13), min = 0,  max = 2),
  swan_c = list(items = paste0("swan_c_", 1:18), min = -3, max = 3)
)

# Safe factor recoding helper
recode_factor_safe <- function(x, values, labels, var_name) {
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  values_chr <- as.character(values)
  unexpected <- setdiff(unique(x_chr[!is.na(x_chr)]), values_chr)
  if (length(unexpected) > 0) {
    warning(
      sprintf(
        "%s: unexpected value(s) %s not in mapping (%s) — these will become NA.",
        var_name,
        paste(unexpected, collapse = ", "),
        paste(values_chr, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  factor(x_chr, levels = values_chr, labels = labels)
}

# Safe numeric conversion helpers

to_numeric_safe <- function(x, var_name) {
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  new_na <- sum(is.na(out) & !is.na(x))
  if (new_na > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("%s: %d value(s) could not be converted to numeric.",
                 var_name, new_na), call. = FALSE)
  }
  out
}

convert_items <- function(dfs, items) {
  lapply(dfs, function(df) {
    missing_cols <- setdiff(items, names(df))
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      stop("Missing item columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
    }
    for (v in items) df[[v]] <- to_numeric_safe(df[[v]], v)
    df
  })
}

#------------
# Main data
#------------
factor_vars <- c("adhd_status", "bc_status", "adhd_med_status", "menarche_status")

completed_dfs <- lapply(completed_dfs, function(df) {
  for (v in factor_vars) {
    df[[v]] <- recode_factor_safe(df[[v]], values = c("N", "Y"), labels = c("N", "Y"), var_name = v)
  }
  return(df)
})

# Scale items -> numeric
items_c <- unlist(lapply(scale_spec[c("pds_c", "ers_c", "smfq_c", "swan_c")], `[[`, "items"))
completed_dfs <- convert_items(completed_dfs, items_c)
```

### 1.2 Derived variables

```{r total-scores-bmi}
# Safeguard for incorrect variable types
stopifnot(
  all(sapply(completed_dfs[[1]][c("age_cont", "sed_percentile", "menarche_timing")], is.numeric)),
  all(sapply(completed_dfs_y[[1]][c("age_cont_y", "sed_percentile")], is.numeric))
)

# Specs and total names
spec_c   <- scale_spec[c("pds_c", "ers_c", "smfq_c", "swan_c")]
spec_y   <- scale_spec[c("pds_y", "ers_y", "smfq_y")]
totals_c <- c(pds_c = "pds_total",   ers_c = "ers_total",
              smfq_c = "smfq_total", swan_c = "swan_total")
totals_y <- c(pds_y = "pds_total_y", ers_y = "ers_total_y",
              smfq_y = "smfq_total_y")

# Helpers

# Simple sum of items (data are imputed, so any NA is an error)
sum_score <- function(df, items) {
  m <- as.matrix(df[items])
  if (anyNA(m)) {
    stop("Missing values found in items: ",
         paste(items[colSums(is.na(m)) > 0], collapse = ", "))
  }
  rowSums(m)
}

# Item range check per imputation, summarised across imputations
check_item_ranges <- function(dfs, spec, label) {
  res <- purrr::imap_dfr(dfs, function(df, i) {
    purrr::imap_dfr(spec, function(s, nm) {
      vals <- unlist(df[s$items])
      tibble(
        imp = i, scale = nm,
        expected_min = s$min, expected_max = s$max,
        observed_min = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
        observed_max = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_out_of_range = sum(vals < s$min | vals > s$max, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_missing_items = sum(is.na(vals))
      )
    })
  })
  summ <- res %>%
    group_by(scale, expected_min, expected_max) %>%
    summarise(observed_min = min(observed_min),
              observed_max = max(observed_max),
              n_out_of_range = sum(n_out_of_range),
              n_missing_items = sum(n_missing_items),
              .groups = "drop")
  cat("\n---", label, "item range check (all imputations) ---\n")
  print(summ)
  if (any(summ$n_out_of_range > 0)) stop(label, ": scale items outside expected range.")
  if (any(summ$n_missing_items > 0)) stop(label, ": missing item values remain after imputation.")
  invisible(summ)
}

add_totals <- function(dfs, spec, totals) {
  lapply(dfs, function(df) {
    for (nm in names(totals)) {
      df[[totals[[nm]]]] <- sum_score(df, spec[[nm]]$items)
    }
    df
  })
}

check_totals <- function(dfs, spec, totals, label) {
  res <- purrr::imap_dfr(dfs, function(df, i) {
    purrr::imap_dfr(totals, function(tot, nm) {
      tibble(
        imp = i, total = tot,
        lo = spec[[nm]]$min * length(spec[[nm]]$items),
        hi = spec[[nm]]$max * length(spec[[nm]]$items),
        observed_min = min(df[[tot]], na.rm = TRUE),
        observed_max = max(df[[tot]], na.rm = TRUE),
        n_missing = sum(is.na(df[[tot]]))
      )
    })
  })
  summ <- res %>%
    group_by(total, lo, hi) %>%
    summarise(observed_min = min(observed_min),
              observed_max = max(observed_max),
              n_missing = sum(n_missing),
              .groups = "drop")
  cat("\n---", label, "total check (all imputations) ---\n")
  print(summ)
  stopifnot(all(summ$observed_min >= summ$lo),
            all(summ$observed_max <= summ$hi),
            all(summ$n_missing == 0))
  invisible(summ)
}

# Pubertal timing = residual of PDS total on age, within each imputation
add_timing <- function(dfs, total, age, out) {
  lapply(dfs, function(df) {
    fit <- lm(reformulate(age, response = total), data = df, na.action = na.exclude)
    df[[out]] <- resid(fit)
    df
  })
}

# Missing/infinite check on derived variables across all imputations
check_derived <- function(dfs, vars, label) {
  res <- purrr::imap_dfr(dfs, function(df, i) {
    tibble(imp = i,
           n_missing  = sum(is.na(df[vars])),
           n_infinite = sum(sapply(df[vars], function(x) sum(is.infinite(x)))))
  }) %>% summarise(across(c(n_missing, n_infinite), sum))
  cat("\n---", label, "derived variable check (all imputations) ---\n")
  print(res)
  stopifnot(res$n_missing == 0, res$n_infinite == 0)
  invisible(res)
}

#-----------------------
# Main (caregiver) data
#-----------------------
check_item_ranges(completed_dfs, spec_c, "Main")
completed_dfs <- add_totals(completed_dfs, spec_c, totals_c)
check_totals(completed_dfs, spec_c, totals_c, "Main")

# BMI
completed_dfs <- lapply(completed_dfs, function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    height_c_1 = to_numeric_safe(height_c_1, "height_c_1"),
    weight_c_1 = to_numeric_safe(weight_c_1, "weight_c_1"),
    height_m   = height_c_1 / 100,
    bmi        = weight_c_1 / (height_m^2)
  )
})

# Pubertal timing
completed_dfs <- add_timing(completed_dfs, "pds_total", "age_cont", "pubertal_timing")

# BMI plausibility across all imputations
bmi_check <- purrr::imap_dfr(completed_dfs, function(df, i) {
  tibble(
    imp = i,
    bmi_min = min(df$bmi, na.rm = TRUE),
    bmi_max = max(df$bmi, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_bmi_implausible = sum(df$bmi < 10 | df$bmi > 60, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})
print(bmi_check)
stopifnot(all(bmi_check$n_bmi_implausible == 0))

check_derived(completed_dfs,
              c("pds_total", "ers_total", "smfq_total", "swan_total", "bmi", "pubertal_timing"),
              "Main")

#------------------
# Young person data
#------------------
check_item_ranges(completed_dfs_y, spec_y, "YP")
completed_dfs_y <- add_totals(completed_dfs_y, spec_y, totals_y)
check_totals(completed_dfs_y, spec_y, totals_y, "YP")

completed_dfs_y <- add_timing(completed_dfs_y, "pds_total_y", "age_cont_y", "pubertal_timing_y")

check_derived(completed_dfs_y,
              c("pds_total_y", "ers_total_y", "smfq_total_y", "pubertal_timing_y"),
              "YP")
```

### 1.3 Standardisation main data

```{r standardise}
continuous_vars <- c(
  "age_cont",
  "sed_percentile",
  "bmi",
  "pds_total",
  "pubertal_timing",
  "menarche_timing",
  "smfq_total",
  "swan_total",
  "ers_total"
)

completed_dfs <- lapply(completed_dfs, function(df) {
  for (v in continuous_vars) {
    if (v %in% names(df)) {
      sd_v <- sd(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
      mean_v <- mean(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
      df[[paste0(v, "_s")]] <- (df[[v]] - mean_v) / (sd_v)
    }
  }
  return(df)
})

# Spot checks
summary(completed_dfs[[1]]$pds_total_s)
mean(completed_dfs[[1]]$pds_total_s)
sd(completed_dfs[[1]]$pds_total_s)
```

```{r multicollinearity}
# Summary table

var_labels <- c(
  # caregiver
  "pds_total_s"         = "Pubertal status",
  "pubertal_timing_s"   = "Pubertal timing (standardised)",
  "adhd_status"         = "ADHD status",
  "age_cont_s"          = "Age (standardised)",
  # young person
  "pds_total_y_s"       = "Pubertal status",
  "pubertal_timing_y_s" = "Pubertal timing (standardised)",
  "adhd_y"              = "ADHD status",
  "age_cont_y_s"        = "Age (standardised)",
  # shared
  "sed_percentile_s"    = "SED (standardised)"
)

tidy_vif <- function(v) {
  if (is.matrix(v)) {
    tibble(Variable = rownames(v), VIF = v[, "GVIF^(1/(2*Df))"]^2)
  } else {
    tibble(Variable = names(v), VIF = as.numeric(v))
  }
}

summarise_vif <- function(vif_list, predictors, model_label) {
  map_dfr(vif_list, tidy_vif, .id = "Imputation") %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    summarise(Min = min(VIF), Max = max(VIF), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(order = match(Variable, predictors)) %>%
    arrange(order) %>%
    mutate(
      Model    = model_label,
      Variable = coalesce(unname(var_labels[Variable]), Variable)  # falls back to raw name
    ) %>%
    select(Model, Variable, Min, Max)
}

vif_table <- bind_rows(
  summarise_vif(vif_results_h1,   predictors_h1,   "H1"),
  summarise_vif(vif_results_h2,   predictors_h2,   "H2"),
  summarise_vif(vif_results_h1_y, predictors_h1_y, "H1 – Young Person"),
  summarise_vif(vif_results_h2_y, predictors_h2_y, "H2 – Young Person")
) %>%
  mutate(
    `VIF Min` = sprintf("%.3f", Min),
    `VIF Max` = sprintf("%.3f", Max)
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Variable, `VIF Min`, `VIF Max`)

vif_table_display <- vif_table %>%
  mutate(Model = if_else(Model == lag(Model, default = ""), "", Model))

vif_table_display

```
